1.say: Drape the blue striped tie around the white collar. Hang the wide pointed end much longer down the shirt front than the narrow short end.
placements: blue striped wide pointed end → down the front center of white shirt, on viewer's right side of the buttons, hanging much longer (in video: right chest, tip below frame)
blue striped narrow short end → down the front center of white shirt, on viewer's left side of the buttons, hanging shorter (in video: left chest with dark tip showing)
watch_for: if both ends look equal length the finished tie will end too short - the wide end must hang much longer
if the tie is twisted around the neck the stripes will not lie flat down the shirt front
1.check_yourself: The blue tie lies around the white collar with both ends hanging down the shirt front, wide end longer.

2.say: Cross the wide blue-striped end over the narrow blue-striped end. Pinch the X together in the middle of the shirt below the collar.
placements: wide blue-striped long end → over the top of the narrow short end at center front just below the white collar, forming an X (in video: crossing in middle of shirt, pinched by hand)
watch_for: if the narrow end is on top of the wide end the X is backwards - the wide end must be on top
if the cross sits up inside the collar you cannot wrap - keep it below the collar in the middle of the shirt
2.check_yourself: The two blue ends cross in the middle of the shirt forming an X below the collar.

3.say: Bring the wide blue end behind the X and up through the neck loop. Pull it straight up through the opening under the collar.
placements: wide blue-striped long end → from front center, behind the crossing, up through the neck loop opening between collar and crossing, exiting pointing up (in video: wide end points up through neck opening with crossing cinched below collar)
watch_for: if you bring the wide end over the front instead of behind it will not lock - it must go behind then up
if the crossing loosens and loses the X, hold the center pinch while you pull up
3.check_yourself: The wide blue end points up through the neck opening with the crossing cinched below the collar.

4.say: Wrap the wide blue end across the front of the knot. Lay the horizontal blue band flat across the center with the tip sticking out to the side.
placements: wide blue-striped long end → horizontally across the front center of the forming knot, tip sticking out sideways (in video: horizontal blue band across center with wide end out to the side on viewer's left)
watch_for: if you wrap above the crossing instead of across its center the band will not form - wrap across the middle
if the band twists the stripes will twist - keep the flat blue face forward
4.check_yourself: A horizontal blue band wraps across the center with the wide end sticking out to the side.

5.say: Pull the wide blue end up through the neck loop again. Drop the tip straight down through the front loop centered over the narrow end.
placements: wide blue-striped long end → up behind through the neck loop under the collar, then down through the horizontal front wrap loop at center front, hanging down over the narrow end (in video: wide end hangs down through front wrap centered over narrow end)
watch_for: if you skip the neck loop and only tuck under the front band the knot will fall apart - go up through the neck first
if the tip twists the stripes will twist - keep the flat blue face forward as you pull down
5.check_yourself: The wide blue end hangs down through the front wrap centered over the narrow end.

6.say: Tighten the blue knot and slide it up to the collar. Center the blue triangle under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the shirt.
placements: blue striped triangular knot → slid up to center under the white collar points, centered over the buttons, with wide end hanging straight down front center (in video: neat triangular blue knot centered under collar with wide end down shirt)
watch_for: if the knot sits low with a gap at the collar it looks unfinished - slide it all the way up while holding the narrow end
if the knot is crooked the wrap is uneven - straighten the triangle so it sits centered
6.check_yourself: A neat triangular blue knot sits centered under the collar with the wide end hanging straight down the shirt.
